#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

bool step(int w, int n, vector<int>& a, int i) {
    if (i > n) {
        return true;
    }
    if (a[i] <= 1) {
        return step(w, n, a, i + 1);
    }
    a[i] += 1;
    if (a[i] == w) {
        int j = i;
        while (j <= n && a[j] >= w) {
            a[j] = 0;
            j++;
            a[j] += 1;
        }
        if (a[j - 1] > 1) {
            return false;
        }
        return step(w, n, a, j);
    } else {
        i++;
        if (a[i - 1] > 1) {
            return false;
        }
        return step(w, n, a, i);
    }
}

bool possible(int w, int n, vector<int>& a) {
    return step(w, n, a, 1);
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    vector<int> a(55, 0);
    int n = 0;
    do {
        a[++n] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    } while (m > 0);
    cout << (possible(w, n, a) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
